ticket: J8 (#1261): the owner, 2026-11-14: "add ALOT more images to the UI. especially on stuff you can do."
prompt:
Use only the two pictures attached to this message (ignore any earlier pictures). They are tile sheets already in this painted isometric golf game: match their style, scale, framing, camera angle, detail level and colours exactly.

Create an image, 4:3 landscape: a sheet of TWELVE tiny isometric dioramas in a 4 x 3 grid. Each scene sits on its own small slab of ground, on its own dark navy (#1E2A44) rounded square; the twelve squares are the same size, evenly spaced, and do not touch, on a flat charcoal (#1C1F26) background. Light from the upper right, soft shadows falling to the lower left, warm autumn colours, the year 1985 (no modern things). NO lettering, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere: every sign, board, paper, tag and screen is blank. No people. Each scene must be easy to tell apart from the others at a small size, with one clear main object. Row by row, left to right:
Row 1: (1) a row of four open-air green hitting mats separated by low white dividers, a ball basket at each; (2) a 1985 golf ball dispenser machine, boxy painted steel with a chute, a wire bucket under the chute catching balls; (3) a small gravel car park with two 1985 cars parked and timber wheel stops; (4) fresh black asphalt with crisp white parking bay lines and a small yellow road roller.
Row 2: (5) a putting green with three holes, each with a tiny flag on a short pin, and a putter lying beside a ball; (6) a tee box with two tee markers, a golf bag on its stand and a ball on a wooden tee, a fairway running away behind; (7) a drawing board on trestles with a blueprint plan of a golf hole (shapes only), a pencil, and two surveyor's stakes in the grass; (8) three young trees held by stakes along the edge of a fairway, with a spade stuck in the soil.
Row 3: (9) a short gravel driveway curving to an open timber gate, with a shovel and two orange road cones; (10) a wheeled seed spreader on raked bare soil with two plain sacks of grass seed; (11) a pallet stacked with rolls of green turf, one roll lying open on the ground; (12) a small yellow bulldozer pushing a heap of rubble and broken planks.
generator: ChatGPT image generation through the chatgpt-bridge (D:/AI/chatgpt-bridge), 2026-11-14
lighting: screen upper-right toward lower-left; soft shadows to the lower left; warm autumn colours; 1985
processing: Native generator output copied byte-for-byte (the generatorSource file has the same sha256); no repaint, resample, mirror, recolour or transform. Cut by scripts/assets/prep-ui-tool-tiles.mjs (version v4) into 144 px rounded WebP tiles in src/assets/ui/tiles/; crop rectangles and hashes in art/ui-tool-tiles/sheet-v4.json.
